name: Highland Village
seo_title: Highland Village Christmas Events for Kids, TX 2026
seo_description: Christmas at the Ranch Dec 12, Santa on a fire engine Dec 13 to 18, and Santa photos with free carriage rides at The Shops at Highland Village.
lede: The story of Christmas in Highland Village mixes a log home built after 1869 with a lakeside suburb that incorporated in the early 1960s. Its signature traditions today are Christmas at the Ranch at Doubletree Ranch Park and Santa riding a Highland Village fire engine through the neighborhoods.
sections: Santa on a fire engine and a ranch full of snow

Every December the Highland Village Fire Department takes Santa out of his sleigh and onto a fire engine. City calendar entries from past years say families will once again see Santa riding through the neighborhoods, waving, and the department posts route maps for each night. In 2026 the rides run nightly from Sunday, December 13 to Friday, December 18. The city also hosts Christmas at the Ranch, which its calendar calls an annual holiday extravaganza, at Doubletree Ranch Park, 310 Highland Village Road, on Saturday, December 12, from 10 am to 2 pm.
From a log home to a lake suburb

William Tipton Minor came to Texas from Alabama in 1869 and soon after bought property in what would become Highland Village, where he built a log home. That house now stands at LLELA in Lewisville. The Handbook of Texas says Highland Village, near Interstate 35E and Farm Road 407 on Lewisville Lake, incorporated in the early 1960s. It grew from 516 residents in 1970 to 3,246 in 1980 and 12,173 in 2000. Today The Shops at Highland Village adds Santa's North Pole Lodge and weekend carriage rides.
The A-train station named for Highland Village

DCTA's Highland Village/Lewisville Lake Station, at 2998 N. Stemmons Freeway in Lewisville, carries the town's name on the A-train line. The line began running on June 20, 2011, from Denton to Trinity Mills Station in Carrollton, where riders change to DART's Green Line. At Christmas DCTA runs Santa at the Station from the Downtown Denton Transit Center on Saturday, December 5, 2026. For a longer train day, the Museum of the American Railroad in Frisco and the Interurban Railway Museum in Plano are a drive away.

faq: When did Highland Village become a city?

The Handbook of Texas says Highland Village incorporated in the early 1960s. It sits on Lewisville Lake near Interstate 35E and Farm Road 407, about ten miles southeast of Denton. The town grew from 516 residents in 1970 to 12,173 in 2000, and the Texas Almanac lists 15,899 at the 2020 census.
How can we follow Santa on the Highland Village fire engine?

The fire department posts the route map for each night on the city calendar, and in 2026 Santa rides from Sunday, December 13 to Friday, December 18, from 6 to 8:30 pm. Families can step outside when the engine turns onto their street. Check the department's route before you head out.
Where is Christmas at the Ranch?

Christmas at the Ranch is at Doubletree Ranch Park, 310 Highland Village Road, on Saturday, December 12, 2026, from 10 am to 2 pm. The city's calendar calls it an annual holiday extravaganza. Past editions included photos with Santa, reindeer, snow hill sledding and trackless trains.
Are the carriage rides at The Shops at Highland Village free?

Yes. The Shops at Highland Village calls the horse drawn carriage rides complimentary and first come, first served. They run Fridays and Saturdays from 4 to 8 pm, with a 5 pm start on November 27, and Sundays from 2 to 6 pm through December 20. Rides do not run in bad weather.
How much are Santa photos at The Shops at Highland Village?

Photo packages start at $40, and the center highly recommends booking a time online through VIP Holiday Photos because walk-up availability is limited. Santa is at the North Pole Lodge through December 24, and Mondays are Santa Paws nights for family pets.
Is there a train station in Highland Village?

DCTA's A-train has a Highland Village/Lewisville Lake Station, with a Lewisville street address, at 2998 N. Stemmons Freeway. The line runs from Denton to Trinity Mills Station in Carrollton, where riders can change to DART's Green Line toward Dallas. DCTA also runs Santa at the Station from Denton on December 5, 2026.
